blocks.html: ISYSTEMS AUTOMATION covers the full project cycle: engineering, procurement, installation supervision, commissioning, acceptance testing and maintenance for industrial control systems.
Work spans DCS and ESD on Emerson Ovation, ABB 800xA, Siemens PCS7, Yokogawa Centum, HIMA and Triconex, plus MES, safety systems and control room design.

Engineering, procurement, installation supervision, commissioning and acceptance testing for DCS and ESD — technical coordination, materials to specification, and documentation to the beneficiary's requirements.
